model: square-lattice Hubbard, t = 1, U = 8 (U/t = 8), periodic clusters, Sz = 0 (N_up = N_dn)
hopping_convention: H = -t sum_i sum_{d=+x,+y} (c^dag c + h.c.) + U sum n_up n_dn; a length-2 periodic direction counts the bond twice (checked against Ku-ku E0)
observable: Ku-ku d-wave pair correlation P_d at the largest minimum-image distance, P_org = 2 P_d (organizer normalization)
pair_operator: b_ij = (c_i_up c_j_dn + c_j_up c_i_dn)/sqrt2; Delta_d(i) = 1/2 sum_{+-x,+-y} g b_{i,i+d}; g(+-x) = +1, g(+-y) = -1
